comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Operates for-profit online and campus universities for adult learners, with nursing/health focus and Title IV-funded tuition, like Perdoceo.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Outsources services to universities for a revenue share; B2B service provider, not an operator of degree-granting institutions.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Small regional California campus-based allied health vocational college group; differs in scale, geography and online adult degree model.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Operates Strayer and Capella online universities for working adults, tuition-funded with Title IV exposure, closely mirroring Perdoceo's model.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Primarily K-12 virtual school provider funded by public school budgets, with curriculum and software sales; different customers and funding.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Campus-based hands-on technician and skilled-trades training for young students; different programs and delivery than online degree universities.
